author: rom-woe
quote: I paid €1,200 for a PS5 Pro and €80 for a game that I can't even trade in after I've played it.I got motion sickness, a girlfriend simulator, and 30 FPS—my first launch was even without sound (right after the opening sequence where you can play as Lucia in prison).I also got input lag, and the story isn't anywhere near GTA 5. It's woke, you can't attack protesters—they put a political agenda into it.Really, really sad.
